simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֹסֶף (H625) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֹסֶף (ʼôçeph) means a collection (of fruits) First listed occurrence: Isa 32 10.

definitions.full: H625. oseph אֹ֫סֶף noun masculine Isa 32:10 gathering (on formation compare Ba NB 109 ) of summer fruit אָסְמֵּיקַֿיִץ Micah 7:1 ; compare absolute אֹסֶף Isa 32:10 ; ׳א הֶחָסִיל gathering of the locust , i.e. as the locust devours, destroys 33:4 .
